landing.title: Devgame
landing.tagline: A roguelike whose dungeon is a Git graph.
landing.pitch: You work on a project that never ends, one commit at a time. At every node there are two ways forward: by hand, slow and safe, or with the AI, fast and risky. Rival bots push to the same main branch, and the repository has no room for everyone.
landing.howItWorks1: Pick a profile, then walk the graph node by node.
landing.howItWorks2: Every commit is a bet, and the odds are shown before you take it.
landing.howItWorks3: Stay ahead long enough to get a bot fired, or leave before it does.
landing.dailySeed: In daily seed mode everyone plays the same map, every UTC day.

play.fired: Fired: the bots left you behind.

unit_tests.name: Unit tests
unit_tests.desc: Makes AI commits more reliable and absorbs a rejected PR without losing ground.

linter.name: Linter
linter.desc: Shows the exact debt and repays a little of it every turn.

pair_programming.name: Pair programming
pair_programming.desc: Cheaper reviews, and one failed roll can be rolled again each sprint.

copilot_v2.name: Copilot v2
copilot_v2.desc: Lowers the risk of AI commits.

strict_typing.name: Strict typing
strict_typing.desc: Improves every roll, whichever way you commit.

documentation.name: Documentation
documentation.desc: One review reads back more AI commits.

observability.name: Observability
observability.desc: Warns a node ahead of a production bug, and shortens the hotfix.

feature_flags.name: Feature flags
feature_flags.desc: Absorbs forced rebases: no node to replay.

sprint_final.name: Final sprint
sprint_final.desc: Trophy from the Fast one. A successful AI commit jumps one more node.

lynx_eye.name: Lynx eye
lynx_eye.desc: Trophy from the Reviewer. Technical debt is shown exactly.

rebase_master.name: Rebase master
rebase_master.desc: Trophy from the Force-pusher. A forced rebase costs no node.

zen.name: Zen
zen.desc: Trophy from the Tortoise. Merges give back more energy.

agile_board.name: Agile board
agile_board.desc: Raises the energy ceiling for the rest of the run.

code_freeze.name: Code freeze
code_freeze.desc: Repays part of the debt right away, then a little every turn.

retrospective.name: Retrospective
retrospective.desc: One review reads back one more AI commit.

war_room.name: War room
war_room.desc: Warns a node ahead of a production bug.

open_source.name: Open source
open_source.desc: Lowers the risk of AI commits.

ci.name: CI
ci.desc: Tests on every commit: each level improves every roll.

auto_linter.name: Auto linter
auto_linter.desc: Makes debt exact and lets it decay on its own.

dependabot.name: Dependabot
dependabot.desc: The obsolete library never comes up again.

auto_rebase.name: Auto rebase
auto_rebase.desc: A forced rebase no longer costs a replayed node.

review_bot.name: Review bot
review_bot.desc: A free review comes around regularly, and more and more often.

monitoring.name: Monitoring
monitoring.desc: Warns a node ahead of a production bug, and shortens the hotfix.

rapide.name: The Fast one
rapide.desc: Moves fast, breaks things often, and leaves you its debt on the way out.

reviewer.name: The Reviewer
reviewer.desc: Steady pace, rejects your PRs. Going for it first eases the whole run.

force_pusher.name: The Force-pusher
force_pusher.desc: Pushes to main without warning and makes you replay nodes.

tortue.name: The Tortoise
tortue.desc: Slow, debt-free, and the hardest one to get fired.

junior.name: Junior
junior.desc: Boundless energy, no instinct for when the machine is lying.

senior.name: Senior
senior.desc: Solid craft commits and steady in a conflict; wary of the AI.

vibe_coder.name: Vibe coder
vibe_coder.desc: All in on the AI, unsure by hand, and the debt is blurrier than ever.

devops.name: DevOps
devops.desc: Starts with CI already in place.

sprint_start.name: Sprint start
sprint_start.desc: The anchor the sprint opens on. You stand there, you do not code there.

commit.name: Commit
commit.desc: An ordinary node on main: by hand or with the AI.

risky.name: Risky node
risky.desc: Goes further, against a noticeably worse roll.

chore.name: Chore
chore.desc: Detour that draws an everyday event.

fork.name: Fork
fork.desc: A node on main a feature branch leaves from.

feature.name: Feature
feature.desc: A node on a branch: while it is open, main does not move.

feature_merge.name: Feature merge
feature_merge.desc: The last node of the branch: merging it grants the skill.

hotfix.name: Hotfix
hotfix.desc: Branch forced by a production bug, to walk before you pick up again.

sprint_merge.name: Sprint merge
sprint_merge.desc: Back into main at the end of the sprint. The merge is the rest.

release.name: Release
release.desc: The last node of the sprint. Resolving it closes the sprint.
